nodes.title: Inference: Bolna architecture inferred blind from the black box (35 checkable statements with confidence, frozen before any code comparison): own Python asyncio orchestration (not Pipecat/LiveKit/Vocode), one websocket session per call, LiteLLM, STT-endpointing turn-taking with 2-word barge-in, extra LLM calls for hangup/voicemail/language, SIP.js-to-FreeSWITCH web calls, Asterisk legacy SIP, AWS ap-south-1 control plane plus a us-east-1 ws cluster. 4 topics contaminated by l4a parity rows and excluded from scoring.

Bolna public teardown: 66 graded claims (48 observed, 12 inferred, 6 vendor-claimed) across surface, API, architecture, pricing/COGS, velocity, India plumbing, failures and v2, each with evidence path or URL.

Observed Bolna stack (DNS + AWS ip-ranges + public bundle): api/ws/ts ALBs bolna-*-prod-ingress-alb in AWS ap-south-1, us.ws in us-east-1; web calls = SIP.js 0.21 over WSS to FreeSWITCH via /web-call/freeswitch-session; default agent = Vobiz + Deepgram nova-3 hi + Azure gpt-4.1-mini + ElevenLabs Turbo v2.5; RAG on LanceDB; Supabase Auth, Stripe, PostHog, Vercel. Docs say default processing is US, contradicting the Mumbai control plane.

Bolna status page 2026-04-20..10-20: 18 incidents, 9 of them upstream Indian telephony (Plivo x3, Vobiz x2, carrier/connectivity x4), 3 model-provider, 2 latency, 2 queue/scheduling (incl. 2026-10-13 India scheduled calls not placed), 1 webhook delay.

nodes.title: Inference: Bolna default-stack COGS about INR 2.0-3.8 per connected min (mid ~2.8) at FX 95; all-in buyer price INR 4.2-8.0/min depending on tier and whether the $0.02 platform fee sits on top; voice-bundle gross margin 46-72% at PAYG, 18-58% at the AWS annual ~4 cents rate. A reported INR 1.75-2 enterprise rate is at or below default-stack COGS, which is consistent with the Mumbai self-hosted inference build-out seen in certificate transparency.

Bolna India plumbing is reactive. No NCPR/DND scrub. Consent is only 'upload proof of opt-in' after a telephony-provider violation report. Calling guardrails are off by default, whole-hour only, with a bypass flag. DLT/PE registration and the RBI/SEBI certificate for the 160-series are left to the buyer. Number KYC needs a CIN and accepts only Pvt Ltd companies. India residency is Enterprise-only and requires Plivo + Azure OpenAI with no BYOK.

Bolna already ships LLM-native setup, so VP's chat-driven setup is parity, not a wedge, against Bolna. It has Studio Auto Build (brief to agent), Ask Bolna in the dashboard, edit-prompt-by-chat (2026-09-09), an MCP server listed as a Claude connector (2026-10-09) and 20 Skills for coding assistants. What is missing: no contact/CRM object, no cross-call memory, no customer-facing optimisation loop.

Does Bolna charge the $0.02/min platform fee on top of the bundled 6-cent rate, or only under BYOK? What does telephony cost per minute on Bolna-hosted Indian numbers? These two unknowns move Bolna's all-in price between INR ~6.1 and ~8.0/min at PAYG.
nodes.closes_when: A trial-account call cost breakdown or invoice shows the platform-fee and telephony line items for an Indian outbound call.

nodes.title: The India calling window is stated as 9:00-21:00 in Bolna's docs but 10:00-21:00 in ledger CMP-27. Which is the TCCCPR primary text, and do vendors' defaults violate it?

nodes.tried: npx rea-agents@6.7.0 analyze-web-bundle against a headless Chromium CDP target (platform.bolna.ai/login) through the agent proxy, with --fetch-source-maps (300 s timeout) and without it (200 s, NODE_USE_ENV_PROXY=1).
nodes.broke: Both runs hung to timeout with empty output. inspect-web-page --include-script-sources plus export-web-scripts worked in under 10 s, inspect-web-network-capture parsed the Playwright HAR, and curl fetched the 145 lazy chunks named in the main bundle. No source maps are served.

nodes.title: Blind calibration lanes get contaminated by their own 'start from what exists' inputs. Four l4a parity.csv Bolna rows quote OSS code (voicemail handler, DTMF flag, language-switch prompt, memory module), and the brief told the lane to read them first.
nodes.mitigation: Build a pre-filtered input pack for any blind lane, with code-derived evidence stripped. Flag contaminated inferences and exclude them from the hit rate, as done in blind-inferences.json.

events.details: Bolna blind lane (account-free) finished. Froze 35 blind architecture inferences before any code comparison (4 flagged as contaminated by l4a parity rows). Wrote 66 graded claims, 22 pre-registered account-phase predictions and a sha256 manifest of raw captures under data/teardown/bolna. REA analyze-web-bundle hung; inspect-web-page + export-web-scripts worked. No sign-ups, logins, demo requests or GitHub/package reads. report.md was refused by the subagent harness, so its text went back to the orchestrator in the structured output.
